Fixes for the pinned widget and for updates. If you installed an earlier version with the installer, the app offers this update by itself. Restart Daybook, or press **Settings → Updates → Check for updates**, to see it straight away.

## Fixed

- **A pinned widget disappeared.** After "show desktop" (Win+D) it was gone, hidden under the wallpaper, and "Show the widget" did nothing. Pinned, it is now tied to the desktop: it is there whenever the desktop is, and sits behind the windows you are working in.
- **"Show the widget" works again.** It brings the widget to the front, pinned or not, from the icon by the clock, Ctrl+Shift+D, or starting Daybook a second time.
- **You can unpin it.** A pinned widget could only be unpinned deep in Settings, so it looked stuck. The pin button now stays on the widget: press it to unpin, drag the widget where you want it, press it again. The same switch is in the menu of the icon by the clock.
- **Updates were noticed too late.** The app looked for a new version only twice a day, so a version released while it was open went unseen until the next day. It now looks every hour and every time you open the panel.

## Changed

- Double-click the icon by the clock to open the panel.
- **Settings → Updates** is the first thing in Settings, with a **Check for updates** button that says whether you have the newest version or a newer one is out, and when it last checked. The menu of the icon by the clock has "Check for updates" too.

## Downloading

- **Windows:** `Daybook-Setup-1.4.1.exe` (installs, and updates itself) or `Daybook-1.4.1-portable.exe` (runs without installing). Windows will say *"Windows protected your PC"*. Press **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** `Daybook-1.4.1-mac.dmg`. The first time, macOS refuses to open it. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and press **Open Anyway** next to Daybook.

Both warnings are about the missing paid signing certificates, not about the program. The source is all in this repository if you would rather build it yourself.
